episodes.synopsis: Ash Ketchum, a 10-year-old from Pallet Town, is finally old enough to receive his first Pokémon! However, he oversleeps, and the only remaining Pokémon at Professor Oak's lab is a strong-willed Pikachu!
episodes.title: Pokémon - I Choose You!

episodes.synopsis: Ash rushes into Viridian City with his gravely wounded Pikachu. The city's on high alert for Pokémon thieves-thieves like Jessie, James, and Meowth of Team Rocket, a group of bad guys dedicated to stealing valuable Pokémon.
episodes.title: Pokémon Emergency!

episodes.synopsis: Ash discovers and catches a Caterpie—his first Pokémon capture! Though Ash is excited, Misty is grossed out by Bug-type Pokémon, so she is repulsed by its attempts to be friends with her. At night, as Ash and Misty sleep, Caterpie shares with Pikachu its dream of evolving into a Butterfree.
episodes.title: Ash Catches a Pokémon

episodes.synopsis: Misty and Ash continue to wander the Viridian Forest when they spot a Weedle. As Ash battles it, he's distracted by a boy dressed as a samurai and calling himself (naturally) Samurai. Samurai challenges Ash to a battle, and Ash gets the advantage when his Metapod defends itself against Samurai's Pinsir. Samurai sends out his own Metapod—and a standoff begins.
episodes.title: Challenge of the Samurai

episodes.synopsis: Jessie, James, and Meowth dig a trap for our heroes, but they end up falling into it themselves! Ash and Misty arrive at Pewter City and meet a curious fellow named Flint, who notices that Pikachu is tired and shows them the way to the Pokémon Center.
episodes.title: Showdown in Pewter City

episodes.synopsis: Will Team Rocket steal the Moon Stone? Are there other Clefairy lurking about, and do they carry Moon Stones, too? And is the legend of the Moon Stone true?
episodes.title: Clefairy and the Moon Stone

episodes.synopsis: Ash seeks the Cascade badge in Cerulean City—but for some reason, Misty doesn't want to join them. When Ash and Brock show up, the city is buzzing about a break-in that just took place—and are initially accused of the crime!
episodes.title: The Water Flowers of Cerulean City

episodes.synopsis: On the way to Vermillion City, Ash meets AJ, a Gym Leader at an unsanctioned Gym who has 98 wins and zero losses. They battle, and Ash is surprised that AJ's Ground-type Sandshrew can easily beat his Flying-type Pokémon.
episodes.title: The Path to the Pokémon League

episodes.synopsis: While searching for firewood in the foggy woods, Ash and Pikachu discover a bunch of prep-school kids bullying a classmate named Joe.
episodes.title: The School of Hard Knocks

episodes.synopsis: Ash and Misty, while arguing, discover an Oddish. As Misty's Starmie weakens the Oddish, a Bulbasaur appears and fights Starmie while the Oddish runs off into the woods.
episodes.title: Bulbasaur and the Hidden Village

episodes.synopsis: Our friends, lost, discover an injured Charmander. Pikachu talks to it and learns that it's been waiting a long time for its trainer to return.
episodes.title: Charmander - The Stray Pokémon

episodes.synopsis: Ash and his friends walk along a path and fall into a hole dug by a batch of mischievous Squirtle. Ash climbs out and tries to battle them, but they scatter when Officer Jenny arrives.
episodes.title: Here Comes the Squirtle Squad

episodes.synopsis: A tremendously large shadow begins to take form in the sea mists, but this possible discovery could be hindered due to the infamous Team Rocket lurking in the background cooking up another one of their schemes.
episodes.title: Mystery at the Lighthouse

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes finally reach Vermillion City, and they discover that the Pokémon Center is filled with Pokémon hurt during battles with Lt. Surge, the Vermillion City Gym Leader.
episodes.title: Electric Shock Showdown

episodes.synopsis: Ash and his friends board a fancy cruise ship called the St. Anne, thanks to tickets provided by two friendly but familiar-looking people. We soon learn that they're actually Jessie and James in disguise!
episodes.title: Battle Aboard the St. Anne

episodes.synopsis: The St. Anne has capsized and sunk with Ash, the gang, and Team Rocket trapped inside. Now, both sides must put aside their differences in order to escape.
episodes.title: Pokémon Shipwreck

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes and Team Rocket beat the odds by surviving the sinking ship, they are dragged into another potentially deadly situation when they are attacked by the ferocious Pokémon, Gyarados.
episodes.title: Island of the Giant Pokémon

episodes.synopsis: Ash and his friends have finally arrived in Porta Vista, a beach-side tourist town. After destroying an old man's ship, they must help in the old man's business. To attempt to pay the man back faster, Misty enters a beauty contest, only to discover she is competing against Jessie and James.
episodes.title: Beauty and the Beach

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes arrive at Hutber Port, where a ferryboat line runs to the mainland.
episodes.title: Tentacool & Tentacruel

episodes.synopsis: After leaving Acapulco in search of Saffron City, our heroes finally arrive at a small port town in the middle of celebrating a summer festival.
episodes.title: The Ghost of Maiden's Peak

episodes.synopsis: When the party sees a flock of Butterfree flying above the ocean, Brock, as a Pokémon breeder, explains that it is the Butterfree's egg-laying season.
episodes.title: Bye Bye Butterfree

episodes.synopsis: The party finally arrives in Saffron City where a young girl manages a gym of Pokémon using her psychic powers. If Ash defeats this particular Gym Leader, Ash can earn a gold badge.
episodes.title: Abra and the Psychic Showdown

episodes.synopsis: In search of a ghost Pokémon, Ash heads immediately for a tower in Lavender Town where they are said to dwell.
episodes.title: The Tower of Terror

episodes.synopsis: Unbeknownst to Ash, one of the ghost Pokémon decides to join Ash and friends on their journey and more importantly help Ash battle the powerful Saffron City Gym Leader.
episodes.title: Haunter Versus Kadabra

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Celadon City, our heroes encounter Mankey, a wild Pokémon that if rubbed the wrong way can go into uncontrollable fits. Not realizing its unpredictability, the party accidentally upsets Mankey.
episodes.title: Primeape Goes Bananas

episodes.synopsis: The party arrives in Celadon City, a perfectly pleasant town full of large department stores, condominiums, and fancy arcades.
episodes.title: Pokémon Scent-sation!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes come to a town in which a great deal of children have recently turned up missing.
episodes.title: Hypno's Naptime

episodes.synopsis: At Brock's persistent request, our heroes stop by Caesar Street, a town of breeders famous for its Pokémon beauty salons.
episodes.title: Pokémon Fashion Flash

episodes.synopsis: In the outskirts of Fuchsia City, our heroes come across Hitmonchan, a fighter-Pokémon. With little thought, Ash attempts to capture it, but he and Pikachu are badly defeated.
episodes.title: The Punchy Pokémon

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes make their way through the industrial town of Gringy City, Pikachu, perhaps weary from travel, is in a strange state; the electric sacks on his cheeks are continually twitching as though overcharged.
episodes.title: Sparks Fly for Magnemite

episodes.synopsis: Ash, Brock, Misty and Pikachu are lost deep in the mountains. As they press forward on a rough road not even shown on their map, they suddenly hear a large explosion.
episodes.title: Dig Those Diglett!

episodes.synopsis: Fuchsia Gym, the authorized gym where Ash seeks his next badge, turns out to be a hidden ninja's lair. After finally discovering and entering the gym, he is held up by a complex system of traps.
episodes.title: The Ninja-Poké Showdown

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes come to a prairie where the Laramies, a family of Pokémon Ranchers live. They learn from a daughter of the Laramie family that a race is held at the ranch once a year to measure the growth of everyone's Pokémon.
episodes.title: The Flame Pokémon-athon!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes accompany Officer Jenny into the forest, intent on pursuing the Pokémon poachers in the area.
episodes.title: The Kangaskhan Kid

episodes.synopsis: Ash and his friends get challenged by Team Rocket in seeing who can capture the most Pokémon within the Safari Zone, with Ash catching a whole herd of Tauros. As soon as Ash and his friends head out Pokémon hunting, Team Rocket manages to get the drop on the game warden (Mr. Kaiza) and forces him into giving up the location on where Dratini is (the Dragon Valley). In the end, Ash, his friends, Team Rocket, and Kaiza end up seeing the legendary Dratini and Dragonair, with the heroes saving the day.
episodes.title: The Legend of Miniryu

episodes.synopsis: Ash and the others happen upon a town that can only be reached by a long bike bridge, but they don't have enough money to rent bikes for the crossing.
episodes.title: The Bridge Bike Gang

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes take shelter in a cabin that turns out to be the Copycat House of a trainer who has a Pikachu that is a Ditto, the Transform Pokémon.
episodes.title: Ditto's Mysterious Mansion

episodes.synopsis: Ash and his friends arrive at Pokémon Center where the PokéBall transfer machine has been causing problems, as the transferred Pokémon never end up at the other side. Ash and his friends decide to accompany Porygon, a computerized Pokémon, used by Professor Akihabara to investigate the problem, only to discover Team Rocket and another Porygon are to blame.
episodes.title: Cyber Soldier Porygon

episodes.synopsis: Ash and the others discover a group of wild Pikachu in a secluded area of the woods. How will Pikachu feel seeing others of its kind in the wild?
episodes.title: Pikachu's Goodbye

episodes.synopsis: Tracing a path through the woods, the party comes across a tree baited with a plate of food and water. An Eevee is bound to the trunk with string.
episodes.title: The Battling Eevee Brothers

episodes.synopsis: On empty stomachs, our heroes' search for food brings them to a small village, but find there is no food at the bakery nor at the grocery store; even the town restaurant is out of food.
episodes.title: Wake Up, Snorlax!

episodes.synopsis: In the middle of a terrible desert, our heroes inadvertently wandered into Dark City. With no name but Dark, the city has fallen into ruin.
episodes.title: Showdown at Dark City

episodes.synopsis: After discovering there's a traveling carnival nearby, Ash, Misty and Brock join in on the fun of the fair and stumble across a rather dull magic show.
episodes.title: The March of the Exeggutor Squad

episodes.synopsis: Team Rocket never let up with their constant interception, but today something seems strange. The coin on Meowth's forehead is blinking red, indicating overheating.
episodes.title: The Problem with Paras

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes trudge along, resigning themselves to the idea of camping out in the desert as the sun slowly sets. Suddenly they see bright lights in front of them: a glamorous city appears before them, covered in neon lights.
episodes.title: The Song of Jigglypuff

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes approach Grampa Canyon, famous for the beautiful scenery of its valley. As they approach, however, they find wave upon wave of people also heading for Grampa Canyon.
episodes.title: Attack of the Prehistoric Pokémon

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes sleep peacefully, Pikachu begins experiencing an unusual sensation. As though it were choking on something, Pikachu's expression grows steadily more and more pained.
episodes.title: A Chansey Operation

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes pass the entrance to a small village, they stop in front of a strange sign.
episodes.title: Holy Matrimony!

episodes.synopsis: As Ash sits on a rock, staring at his Pokédex, it displays Farfetch'd, an odd-looking Pokémon holding a leek.
episodes.title: So Near, Yet So Farfetch'd

episodes.synopsis: When Ash and friends reach a certain Pokémon E. R., Joy informs Ash that a message has arrived for him, from Professor Oak.
episodes.title: Who Gets to Keep Togepi?

episodes.synopsis: After Bulbasaur's bulb begins to emit an odd glow, a nurse runs some tests and discovers that Bulbasaur isn't sick: It's getting ready to evolve!
episodes.title: Bulbasaur's Mysterious Garden

episodes.synopsis: Misty and Jessie compete against one another for Queen of the Princess Festival, a day where women rule and the guys have to do whatever the girls tell them.
episodes.title: Princess vs. Princess

episodes.synopsis: It's Kids Day, and Ash and friends help the children at a nearby school celebrate the holiday.
episodes.title: The Purr-fect Hero

episodes.synopsis: Ash enrolls Pikachu in a training school for police Growlithe, but the course is tougher than he imagined, for himself and for Pikachu!
episodes.title: The Case of the K-9 Caper!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends are being shadowed by Todd Snap, the world's greatest Pokémon photographer.
episodes.title: Pokémon Paparazzi

episodes.synopsis: Ash signs up to take an exam to be admitted to the Pokémon League.
episodes.title: The Ultimate Test

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes discover a terrible secret about the new breeding center in town.
episodes.title: The Breeding Center Secret

episodes.synopsis: Ash, Brock and Misty travel to Cinnabar Island where Ash hopes to win his Volcano Badge.
episodes.title: Riddle Me This (1)

episodes.synopsis: Ash continues his quest to attain his Volcano Badge once he finally locates the gym that is suspended above a pool of molten lava!
episodes.title: Volcanic Panic (2)

episodes.synopsis: As Ash and the gang are rushing to catch the last ferry off of Cinnabar Island, they stumble over a rare Pokémon in trouble.
episodes.title: Beach Blank-Out Blastoise

episodes.synopsis: One of Misty's water Pokémon is in desperate need of exercise, so the gang decides to take her Horsea to a gym that's run by her sisters in Cerulean City.
episodes.title: The Misty Mermaid

episodes.synopsis: Ash, Brock and Misty get sidetracked on their way to Viridian City when all of their belongings mysteriously disappear.
episodes.title: Clefairy Tales

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends finally make their way to Viridian City where Ash hopes to earn his Earth Badge.
episodes.title: The Battle of the Badge

episodes.synopsis: On their way back to Pallet Town, Ash, Brock and Misty encounter a runaway Mr. Mime.
episodes.title: It's Mr. Mime Time!

episodes.synopsis: Ash, Misty, Brock, and their Pokémon must return a lost Jynx to Santa before Christmas, with the help of a Lapras. Meanwhile, Jessie attempts to take revenge on Santa for stealing her favorite doll when she was young.
episodes.title: Holiday Hi-Jynx

episodes.synopsis: Pikachu is lost in a snowy mountain forest! Can Ash and the gang stay warm while tracking down their missing pal?
episodes.title: Snow Way Out!

episodes.synopsis: Back in Pallet Town, Ash finds Gary, already there, waiting to partake in the Pokémon League. Always having a bitter rivalry with Gary, Professor Oak tells them both the meaning of Pokémon. Meanwhile, Team Rocket is trying to get inside the lab to steal the Pokémon.
episodes.title: Showdown at the Po-ké Corral

episodes.synopsis: Ash goes to Seafoam Island to help Professor Oak to discover the mystery of how Slowpoke evolves into Slowbro. There, Professor Westwood V is also trying to solve the mystery. Jessie captures Shellder, and tries to rush a Slowpoke's evolution, forcing Psyduck to stall the evolution.
episodes.title: The Evolution Solution

episodes.synopsis: Ash and the gang take some time off to go surfing. While surfing, however, Ash passes out, but is thankfully rescued by a surfer named Victor and his blue-eyed Pikachu, Puka. Victor then reveals his plans to surf a tsunami called Humungadunga and become a surfing legend.
episodes.title: The Pi-Kahuna

episodes.synopsis: Ash goes to a flower garden to get some fertilizer for his mother, but Bulbasaur sniffs the flowers and becomes paralyzed.
episodes.title: Make Room for Gloom

episodes.synopsis: When the gang discovers there is a movie with an all-Pokémon cast being made nearby, Ash and his friends put their Pokémon in for an audition. Misty's Psyduck gets the main role while the others get minor roles.
episodes.title: Lights, Camera, Quack-tion

episodes.synopsis: Ash and his friends go to Hollywood (although only a small nearby town) to see the premiere of the movie their Pokémon were cast in. Team Rocket follows them to find out that Meowth has history in this town; It is here where he was a member of a gang of street Meowths led by the Persian. He learned to speak and walk upright to win the heart of a female Meowth who was abandoned by her owner. Upon returning, he challenges Persian who was once his mentor for the female Meowth he thought he lost years before.
episodes.title: Go West Young Meowth

episodes.synopsis: After watching Elite Four member Bruno on TV, Ash and his friends decide to do training in the mountains to be as strong as Bruno. However, they meet Bruno and he manipulates them to do some menial tasks for him. Meanwhile, a giant Onix is on a rampage.
episodes.title: To Master the Onixpected!

episodes.synopsis: While training, Ash and his friends accidentally uncover the ruins of Pokémopolis, an ancient city. After a bit of research, they find a giant Gengar and a giant Alakazam starting to fight. Then, a giant Jigglypuff appears to put them to sleep.
episodes.title: The Ancient Puzzle of Pokémopolis

episodes.synopsis: Ash and his friends offer to help a trainer that is heading for the Pokémon League to retrieve his stolen gym badges from Team Rocket.
episodes.title: Bad to the Bone

episodes.synopsis: Ash finally reaches the Indigo Plateau, home of the Pokémon League conference. Before the tournament begins, they plan on lighting a ceremonial cauldron with the flame of the legendary Pokémon, Moltres. Ash, as a participant, is free to carry the flame but when Team Rocket steals it, the tournament may be cancelled.
episodes.title: All Fired Up!

episodes.synopsis: Ash enters his first match of the tournament on the water field against Mandi the Astounding. During the battle against Mandi's Exeggutor, Ash's Krabby evolves into Kingler, who he then uses against Mandy's remaining Seadra and Golbat, winning the match and moving onto the next preliminary round.
episodes.title: Round One - Begin!

episodes.synopsis: For the second round Ash battles in the rock arena. Ash's last Pokémon, Squirtle, defeats his foe's last Pokémon, Nidorino, and he, victorious, moves on to Round 3. In the third round Ash faces a trainer named Pete in the ice arena. Both trainers are left with 2 Pokémon each. Pete uses Cloyster and Arcanine. In the end, Ash is victorious and he moves on to Round 4.
episodes.title: Fire and Ice

episodes.synopsis: In the 4th round, Ash faces a trainer named Jeanette, who uses a Beedrill, a Scyther, and a Bellsprout. The match ends with Ash victorious, and he moves on to the 5th round, becoming one of the final sixteen members of the tournament.
episodes.title: The Fourth Round Rumble

episodes.synopsis: Ash meets a new trainer named Richie, who is eerily similar to Ash, including owning a Pikachu. However, Team Rocket makes another attempt to steal Ash's and Richie's Pokémon. Ash and Richie prevent Team Rocket from stealing their Pokémon. Ash discovers his next battle is against Richie. Will Ash manage to reach the quarterfinals?
episodes.title: A Friend in Deed

episodes.synopsis: A twist of fate pits Ash and his new friend, Richie, against each other in the fifth round of the Pokémon League Competition. Both are determined to triumph, but who will emerge victorious? And, can their friendship survive the struggle?
episodes.title: Friend and Foe Alike

episodes.synopsis: After losing to Richie in the fifth round, Ash is moping around, annoyed that he lost. He is convinced by Misty that he should support Richie who is now in the quarterfinals. However, when Richie loses, they both have to look inside themselves to see if they are good trainers.
episodes.title: Friends to the End

episodes.synopsis: After battling in the Pokémon League Tournament, Ash and his friends return to Pallet Town for a hero's welcome.
episodes.title: Pallet Party Panic

episodes.synopsis: Ash, Brock, and Misty prepare for their long journey to Valencia Island to bring back a mysterious Poké Ball for Professor Oak. After discovering that the trip will take a month to get there, Ash manages to win a free blimp ride so it will take only a day! Once on board, they realize the blimp is being powered by Team Rocket! And things only get worse from there!
episodes.title: A Scare in the Air

episodes.synopsis: After making a crash landing onto Valencia Island, our heroes get directions to Professor Ivy's laboratory where the mysterious Pokéball is being held. Once at the laboratory, Brock realizes that Professor Ivy and her group of scientists are Pokémon breeders just like him! Suddenly Brock begins to feel at home and thinks about staying for awhile to continue his studies on Pokémon breeding.
episodes.title: Pokéball Peril

episodes.synopsis: After picking up the GS Ball from Professor Ivy, Brock decided to stay on the island so Ash and Misty head back home by blimp. Unfortunately, our duo gets double-crossed by Team Rocket once again, and Jigglypuff puts the whole crew to sleep. After another crash landing in the middle of nowhere they meet a new friend named Tracey while trying to help a Lapras that washed up on the beach.
episodes.title: The Lost Lapras

episodes.synopsis: Ash, Misty and their new friend, Tracey, are on a new adventure exploring the Orange Islands as Ash sets out to qualify for the Orange League Tournament. After hearing that the Mikan Gym Leader is known as one of the toughest trainers in the Orange Crew, Ash can't wait for the challenge. He learns that Pokémon battles are run a little differently on the Orange Islands, but he can always rely on his Squirtle to pull them through!
episodes.title: Fit To Be Tide

episodes.synopsis: Just as Ash, Misty, and Tracey set foot on Mandarin Island, Pikachu and Togepi turn against them and join a group of other angry Pokémon. When the misbehaving Pokémon disappear, Officer Jenny arrives and informs them that dozens of Pokémon have been reported missing, including Meowth! Everyone fears a Psychic attack is behind this mystery. Will Jessie and James actually join forces with our heroes? Could they possibly win a battle for the first time?
episodes.title: Pikachu Re-Volts

episodes.synopsis: While riding around the Orange Islands on his Lapras, Ash finds a mysterious message in a bottle, which leads the gang on a new adventure. Ash, Misty and Tracey travel to Sunburst Island, which is famous for its artists and glassblowers. They meet a struggling young shopkeeper who's seeking inspiration from a legendary crystal Onix. Having been unable to find this special Pokémon, the shopkeeper turns to our heroes. With Tracey and his observational Pokémon on board, they set out to fire up a new friend's creative drive!
episodes.title: The Crystal Onix

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends are caught in a whirlpool and swept to an unexplored island where all the Pokémon are pink. It's Pinkan Island, a Pokémon refuge where the Pokémon's diet of Pinkan Berries causes their unique coloration. But the Pokémon aren't all as sweet as they look. Our heroes cross paths with an enraged Nidoking, and end up cornered under a cliff.
episodes.title: In the Pink

episodes.synopsis: Aboard Lapras, the group follows a news crew to an uninhabited island, where a scientific expedition is underway after the discovery of a fossilized Kabuto. A series of natural disasters place our heroes in mortal danger, with only the power of their Pokémon to help them. What is the secret of the Kabuto, and who wants that secret to remain hidden?
episodes.title: Shell Shock!

episodes.synopsis: Misty meets another female trainer who also is an expert on water Pokémon. The new trainer notices some signs that Misty's Psyduck may be ready to evolve. As the two prepare for a Pokémon battle, a Golduck springs from the water and battles for Misty. With her powerful new Pokémon, can Misty defeat both her newfound friend and Team Rocket?
episodes.title: Stage Fight!

episodes.synopsis: After stopping on another island to rest, Misty notices her Psyduck's tail is glowing, a nearby trainer says it may mean it is time for it to evolve. So Misty challenges her to battle and when she finds she has a Golduck, she easily beats the trainer. However, Team Rocket has other plans. Later, Golduck turns out to be a wild Pokémon as Misty's Psyduck makes an appearance.
episodes.title: Bye Bye Psyduck

episodes.synopsis: While riding Ash's Lapras to the next island, Ash and the gang come across a tanned Nurse Joy who insists on healing Wild Water Pokémon on the island. Ash and Tracey decide to help out, but when Team Rocket arrives to stop them, a giant Magikarp arrives.
episodes.title: The Joy of Pokémon

episodes.synopsis: The group arrive on Navel Island where Ash finds himself up against the Gym Leader, Danny as Ash competes for his second Orange League badge. Misty tries to tempt Ash by showing more caring attitude to Danny. Ash once again gets jealous and sad.
episodes.title: Navel Maneuvers

episodes.synopsis: Arriving on the Grapefruit Islands, Ash discovers that there is a Snorlax going from island to island eating all the grapefruits. Ash is employed to help stop the Snorlax, but the Snorlax proves to be slippery. Later on, Ash captures the Snorlax.
episodes.title: Snack Attack

episodes.synopsis: Arriving on Moro Island, Ash and his friends hear about a long lost Orange League Trophy being found on a sunken ship, but when Team Rocket steals it, Ash and the gang follow them to a ghost ship inhabited by a Gastly and Haunter.
episodes.title: A Shipful of Shivers

episodes.synopsis: Meowth finds himself on an island where the inhabitants believe him to be a "Meowth God".
episodes.title: Meowth Rules!

episodes.synopsis: Arriving on Murcott Island, Ash and his friends discover a wounded Scyther. After capturing it, Tracey must take it to a Pokémon Center. While there, he discovers the Scyther got dethroned from being in charge of his group.
episodes.title: Tracey Gets Bugged

episodes.synopsis: Deciding to take a break on a nearby island, Ash, his friends, and all their Pokémon just use the time to relax and get better acquainted. However, Team Rocket has other plans for the Pokémon and intend to steal them.
episodes.title: A Way Off Day Off

episodes.synopsis: The group descend on Mandarin Island where Ash's arrogance emerges due to the fact that he's won every single battle he's had since arriving on the island but upon meeting Prima, a member of the Elite Four and challenging her to a battle, Ash starts to realize that he may have made a grave mistake.
episodes.title: The Mandarin Island Miss Match

episodes.synopsis: Still on Mandarin Island, Ash and his friends go through Victorian Town where they find two Nidoran who are in love with each other but any possible hint of a relationship is being derailed by the trainers who happen to be childhood rivals.
episodes.title: Wherefore Art Thou, Pokémon

episodes.synopsis: Ash and his friends discover a man who has troops of Magnemite and has to take them to a town on the island in order to give it power. However, he gets injured, so it is up to Ash to herd up the Magnemite and get to the town.
episodes.title: Get Along, Little Pokémon

episodes.synopsis: Heading to the other end of Mandarin Island, Ash and his friends discover there's a monster in the sewer that is causing lots of problems in the town. When the Mayor wants to blow it up, Joy protests and asks Ash and company to help.
episodes.title: The Mystery Menace

episodes.synopsis: Ash arrives on Trovita Island prepared to battle for his third Orange League Gym Badge. However, much to Ash's dismay, the Gym Leader, Rudy has more than just battling on his mind, Rudy develops a crush on Misty, and Ash gets jealous once again. Rudy moves in to court Misty after she helps rescue his younger sister, Mahri. While Ash battles for the Spike Shell Badge, Misty considers the tempting offer to stay on the island with Rudy and Mahri forever.
episodes.title: Misty Meets Her Match

episodes.synopsis: After getting his 3rd Orange League Badge, Ash and his friends arrive on an island, where Pikachu is soon captured by Team Rocket and is chained to Meowth. But soon after Pikachu and Meowth are taken away by a giant Pidgeot, the trapped rivals eventually learn how to get along.
episodes.title: Bound for Trouble

episodes.synopsis: After hearing about Ash from the Trovita Island gym leader, another trainer seeks him out for a battle. When Pikachu is knocked out during the battle, Ash turns to his Charizard, but he struggles to make the unruly Pokémon listen to him.
episodes.title: Charizard Chills

episodes.synopsis: On the next island, Ash and his friends see a team of firefighters consisting of Squirtles, Wartortles, and Blastoises. Eager to test its skills, Ash's Squirtle get to train with them. But when an actual fire turns up, training has to become reality.
episodes.title: The Pokémon Water War

episodes.synopsis: While in a battle, Ash accidentally breaks Snorlax's Pokéball. With the Pokémon Center on the other side of the island, Ash and his friends have to get Snorlax there. And to make matters worse, Team Rocket arrive and are hoarding the island's food ransom until they get Pikachu.
episodes.title: Pokémon Food Fight!

episodes.synopsis: On Kumquat Island, Ash discovers Luana, the final Orange Island Gym Leader, who mistakes him for her son. After defending the island from Team Rocket, they head to the Gym to have a Double Battle where Pikachu and Charizard battle against Marowak and Alakazam but Pikachu's and Charizard's unwillingness to work together might end up costing Ash his chance of qualifying for the Orange League.
episodes.title: Pokémon Double Trouble

episodes.synopsis: On Rind Island, Tracey meets Dr. Quackenpoker, a noted Pokémon Watcher who is doing a study on the Magikarp that climb up waterfalls and how they evolve into Gyarados. However, Team Rocket appears to steal the Magikarp and get them to evolve.
episodes.title: The Wacky Watcher!

episodes.synopsis: On Tiny Island, Ash and Tracey get affected by Stun Spore leaving it up to Misty to get an antidote to heal them. Can Misty find it with the help of her new Poliwag?
episodes.title: The Stun Spore Detour

episodes.synopsis: After winning his way to the final competition for the Orange League Winner's Trophy, victory seems a long shot for Ash as the Gym Leader deploys a powerful Gengar that topples one of Ash's Pokémon after another.
episodes.title: Hello, Pummelo!

episodes.synopsis: As if a gym battle with a Dragonite isn't challenge enough for one day, Team Rocket secretly surveys the weakened state of Ash's battling Pokémon and plots to turn the situation to their advantage.
episodes.title: Enter the Dragonite

episodes.synopsis: It's piracy on the open seas and Ash and friends must rescue a local school of Lapras from would-be poachers, but how can they be of help when the Lapras, conditioned to fear humans, shun the young Trainers?
episodes.title: Viva Las Lapras

episodes.synopsis: Having to travel by boat, Ash and his friends arrive on Hamlin Island, their final stop before returning to Kanto to discover that the town is being attacked by hundreds of Electrode. A man named Poncho is trying to stop them with his Diglett.
episodes.title: The Underground Round-Up

episodes.synopsis: They’re back in Pallet Town. When they get home, they discover Brock is back and he won’t explain why he left Valencia Island. However, as usual, Team Rocket try to steal all of the Pokémon in Oak’s lab by vacuuming all the Pokéballs, including the GS Ball that Oak was working on. Can they get it back?
episodes.title: A Tent Situation

episodes.synopsis: An errand of Professor Oak's sets Ash on the road once again, but first he must face his old hometown rival, Gary, in a Pokémon battle.
episodes.title: The Rivalry Revival

episodes.synopsis: Ash begins his journey in Johto, a largely unexplored region said to be thickly populated with Pokémon entirely new to him and his friends.
episodes.title: Don't Touch That 'dile

episodes.synopsis: In a Pokémon battle, Ash soundly defeats an ambitious young Trainer, who runs away dejectedly.
episodes.title: The Double Trouble Header

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends discover a forest where invading Pinsir are causing heavy deforestation.
episodes.title: A Sappy Ending

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends stumble into a small valley where Donphan are used to harvest precious stones.
episodes.title: Roll On, Pokémon!

episodes.synopsis: Who would be foolish enough to brave a thick forest in the dead of night without a Hoothoot guide? Certainly not Ash Ketchum...
episodes.title: Illusion Confusion!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes must help prepare an insecure Bellossom dance troupe for their upcoming exhibition.
episodes.title: Flower Power

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends reach a new town and hear of three mysterious robbers apparently mimicking the crimes of a legendary master thief.
episodes.title: Spinarak Attack

episodes.synopsis: With pet food prepared by a French chef, rooms of WalkMaster exercise equipment and closets stocked with the latest in Pokémon fashion, life couldn't be much better for a Palm Hills Snubbull.
episodes.title: Snubbull Snobbery

episodes.synopsis: Brock saves a lost and frightened Stantler fawn and carefully nurses it back to health before releasing it.
episodes.title: The Little Big Horn

episodes.synopsis: Ash encounters a wild Chikorita and engages it in battle, thinking to add it to his team.
episodes.title: The Chikorita Rescue

episodes.synopsis: Professor Oak's errand—to deliver the mysterious GS Ball to a Poké Ball expert—is interrupted when a Quagsire with a penchant for spherical objects steals the GS ball for use in a nocturnal ritual.
episodes.title: Once in a Blue Moon

episodes.synopsis: When Team Rocket attacks Ash and his friends, a brave young Trainer and her flock of Ledyba come to the rescue.
episodes.title: The Whistle Stop

episodes.synopsis: Team Rocket can't believe their luck when the Blissey employed in a Pokémon Center willingly gives them the cente's entire food supply.
episodes.title: Ignorance Is Blissey

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes are recruited as guest instructors at a youth Pokémon Academy.
episodes.title: A Bout With Sprout

episodes.synopsis: With Pikachu's help, Ash is confident that winning the Zephyr badge will be a breeze.
episodes.title: Fighting Flyer With Fire

episodes.synopsis: Cute and cuddly is one thing, but a bawling Marill is too much even for Misty.
episodes.title: For Crying Out Loud

episodes.synopsis: Team Rocket's most recent super vehicle, the Arbotank, is their ticket to world domination.
episodes.title: Tanks a Lot!

episodes.synopsis: When Ash hears of the nearby Charicific Valley, he is sure a quick trip would be just the thing to reignite his Charizard's flagging spirits.
episodes.title: Charizard's Burning Ambitions

episodes.synopsis: The annual Sunflora contest is only a day away and yet our hero's new friend and Sunflora Trainer is unable to convince her star Pokémon to compete.
episodes.title: Grin to Win!

episodes.synopsis: A severe case of rivalry between Pikachu and Chikorita calls for therapy sessions with Nurse Joy.
episodes.title: Chikorita's Big Upset

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes chance upon a Hoppip—the fluffy "Cottonweed" Pokémon that is able to drift for miles on a passing wind.
episodes.title: Foul Weather Friends

episodes.synopsis: When Ash and friends wander into town, they bring with them a challenge that threatens to be Gligarman's last—Team Rocket.
episodes.title: The Superhero Secret

episodes.synopsis: Team Rocket comes in sheep's clothing to relieve a kind Poké-shepherd of her Mareep flock.
episodes.title: Mild 'n Wooly

episodes.synopsis: When the most promising trainee at a Pokémon dojo abandons battle altogether, it's up to Ash and friends to convince him that battling is more than just a matter of probability.
episodes.title: Wired for Battle!

episodes.synopsis: With Charizard gone and no fire Pokémon to call his own, Ash is overjoyed to come across a Cyndaquil in the wild.
episodes.title: Good 'Quil Hunting

episodes.synopsis: Ash carelessly makes enemies of the Slowpoke-worshipping residents of a town.
episodes.title: A Shadow of a Drought

episodes.synopsis: Ash delivers the mysterious GS Ball to a renowned Pokémon expert, but Team Rocket wreaks trouble when they attempt to harvest the Apricorns essential to local Poké Ball production.
episodes.title: Going Apricorn!

episodes.synopsis: When Ash reaches the Hive Gym, he has just the Pokémon to challenge the Gym Leader's Bug Pokémon.
episodes.title: Gettin' the Bugs Out

episodes.synopsis: An inexperienced young Trainer mistakenly scares off his own Farfetch'd.
episodes.title: A Farfetch'd Tale

episodes.synopsis: At the Pokémon Swap Meet, our heroes befriend a young Pokémon trainer who's having difficulties finding a trading partner willing to accept his Wobbuffet. When Jessie inadvertently deposits her Poké Ball across from his in the exchanger, this young trainer gets more than he had bargained for.
episodes.title: Tricks of the Trade

episodes.synopsis: Rocket attempts to steal all the water Pokémon from the annual Fire and Rescue Grand Prix.
episodes.title: The Fire-ing Squad!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends enthusiastically volunteer to watch over a troubled trainer's school of Wooper.
episodes.title: No Big Woop!

episodes.synopsis: While Ash and friends deliberate on how to pass through a tunnel replete with Onix, two wandering Pokémon arrive on the scene together.
episodes.title: Tunnel Vision

episodes.synopsis: Investigating a string of mysterious thefts, our heroes discover a pack of Houndour, struggling to survive in the wild.
episodes.title: Hour of the Houndour

episodes.synopsis: Ash and Misty's friendly rivalry is tested when they both try to capture a Totodile at the same time. Unable to determine whose Poké Ball had captured the wild Pokémon, the two must battle it out to determine the Totodile's new master.
episodes.title: The Totodile Duel

episodes.synopsis: When Ash and friends hear of a virtually undefeatable trainer operating nearby, they seek her out.
episodes.title: Hot Matches!

episodes.synopsis: Ash's Totodile falls head over tail for a passing Azumarill, but is still unsuccessful in having its feelings requited when Team Rocket kidnap the Pokémon before Totodile's eyes.
episodes.title: Love, Totodile Style

episodes.synopsis: Ash has his sights set on a rare and brightly-colored Noctowl.
episodes.title: Fowl Play!

episodes.synopsis: When an Ursaring attack leaves Team Rocket and our heroes in compromising positions, compromise they do, members of each team being paired with members of the other.
episodes.title: Forest Grumps

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes come to a town whose residents all raise Psychic Pokémon to repel the Ghost Pokémon that lurk nearby
episodes.title: The Psychic Sidekicks!

episodes.synopsis: A Pokémon Fortune Telling boom turns out to be a Team Rocket plot to steal Pokémon from local trainers.
episodes.title: The Fortune Hunters

episodes.synopsis: Arriving in Goldenrod City, Ash is ready for his next Gym battle, but the Gym appears to be closed. Their plans delayed, our heroes decide to explore the vibrant city.
episodes.title: A Goldenrod Opportunity

episodes.synopsis: After losing to Whitney at the Goldenrod Gym, Ash is thinking of a rematch with her powerful Miltank. When Whitney suggests a trip to a Miltank dairy, it's just the chance he's is looking for!
episodes.title: A Dairy Tale Ending

episodes.synopsis: With his new Gym badge in hand, Ash is asked to appear on a local radio station. But while he's acting out a radio drama with some "professional actors," the scripted danger becomes all too lifelike!
episodes.title: Air Time!

episodes.synopsis: A Bug Pokémon Catching Contest turns into a hive of activity when Ash goes up against his rival Casey-and it isn't long before the Team Rocket villains swarm the scene, intent on catching a few things for themselves...
episodes.title: The Bug Stops Here

episodes.synopsis: On the way to Ecruteak City, our heroes are trapped on the wrong side of a river. To get across, they first have to find a Sudowoodo...which, even for an expert, is no easy feat!
episodes.title: Type Casting

episodes.synopsis: When an ex-student of Professor Oak's discovers some restored Omanyte and Omastar in the wild, our heroes are called into action to save these prehistoric Pokémon from harsh times with Team Rocket!
episodes.title: Fossil Fools

episodes.synopsis: The Pidgey Express courier service is in need of our heroes' helping hands, especially when Team Rocket wants to have the delivery Pidgey signed, sealed, and delivered to the Boss!
episodes.title: Carrying On!

episodes.synopsis: Caught in a sudden downpour, our heroes find a castle clinic that uses Pokémon healers to help patients. But when Brock and the doctor end up trapped in the castle's labyrinth, a helping hand is needed to get them out!
episodes.title: Hassle in the Castle

episodes.synopsis: After meeting the elderly owner of a Pokémon dojo, Ash is called upon to replace the man's granddaughter as the chosen heir! But when a vicious challenger approaches, can Ash help defend the dojo from destruction?
episodes.title: Two Hits and a Miss

episodes.synopsis: Chikorita, Cyndaquil, and Totodile find themselves separated from the group and stuck in a ravine! When Meowth finds himself stuck too, an unlikely partnership forms!
episodes.title: A Hot Water Battle

episodes.synopsis: Misty is reeled into a rivalry at a local Seaking fishing competition. Can she come out on top?
episodes.title: Hook, Line, and Stinker

episodes.synopsis: A Pokémon breeding contest gives our heroes a chance to compete, greet an old friend, and defeat Team Rocket once again!
episodes.title: Beauty and the Breeder

episodes.synopsis: When Ash comes down with a serious stomach ache far from any hospital, a local healer and his Shuckle companions are on task to set him right!
episodes.title: A Better Pill to Swallow

episodes.synopsis: A run-in with his longtime rival Gary leaves Ash in a bad mood. But when Team Rocket's latest weapon starts terrorizing the local Pokémon Center, Ash might have to turn to him for help!
episodes.title: Power Play!

episodes.synopsis: After our heroes meet a mountain patrol and their Ledian partners, they'll have to help protect the mountain from a destructive Team Rocket attack!
episodes.title: Mountain Time

episodes.synopsis: The peace and quiet of a Wobbuffet festival is interrupted by some hooligans picking a fight. Pokémon battles are banned during the festival, so how can our heroes defend the town?
episodes.title: Wobbu-Palooza!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and the gang are happy to see Duplica again...but not as happy as the Team Rocket trio, when they discover her newest Ditto's tiny transformations!
episodes.title: Imitation Confrontation

episodes.synopsis: A Snubbull falls into a Team Rocket trap, and the villains try to ransom it back to its wealthy Trainer. But when the Pokémon fights back, Jessie, James, and Meowth might be the ones in trouble!
episodes.title: The Trouble with Snubbull

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Ecruteak City, our heroes must help a familiar Trainer and her Ariados defend a martial arts center from a rampaging Team Rocket!
episodes.title: Ariados, Amigos

episodes.synopsis: When a young Trainer's Yanma accidentally destroys his father's precious glasswork, it inspires a Team Rocket scheme that will shatter the peace and quiet of the town!
episodes.title: Wings 'N' Things

episodes.synopsis: Hearing of a nearby Grass-type Pokémon tournament, Ash decides to enter...and a rivalry soon begins to bloom amid the heat of battle!
episodes.title: The Grass Route

episodes.synopsis: Pikachu's in trouble when an orchard owner mistakes it for one of the hungry Pichu that have ransacked her harvests. Ash wants to help, but will the fruits of his labor satisfy both the orchard owner and the Pokémon?
episodes.title: The Apple Corp!

episodes.synopsis: When the smoke clears after their latest run-in with Team Rocket, our heroes quickly realize that Togepi is missing! As they begin the search, Togepi has started making friends in another part of the forest.
episodes.title: Houndoom's Special Delivery

episodes.synopsis: Finally reaching Ecruteak City, our heroes set out to find the Gym, but wind up inside a decaying tower instead. Suddenly, the tower bursts into flames with our heroes trapped inside! How can they escape?
episodes.title: A Ghost of a Chance

episodes.synopsis: It is finally time for Ash's fourth Gym battle! After seeing Morty's powerful Gengar in action, Ash is under no illusions about how tough these Ghost-type Pokémon will be! Can he claim the Fog Badge?
episodes.title: From Ghost to Ghost

episodes.synopsis: When our heroes meet five beautiful sisters in a cultural garden, they are soon challenged to a series of testing battles involving Eevee and some of its evolved forms!
episodes.title: Trouble's Brewing

episodes.synopsis: A mischievous flock of Murkrow cause trouble for Ash and Team Rocket by stealing some of their most prized possessions! Now, the race is on to get them back!
episodes.title: All That Glitters!

episodes.synopsis: In a harsh desert landscape, a strange light appears, and a city of ruins rises up before our heroes. But how did the city come to be this way? Could it have something to do with the beautiful light show?
episodes.title: The Light Fantastic

episodes.synopsis: There's a food thief amongst our heroes...could it have anything to do with the cute and cuddly Teddiursa who has joined them on their journey?
episodes.title: UnBEARable

episodes.synopsis: When our heroes are reunited with Pokémon photographer Todd Snap, he starts them on an adventure to find the Legendary Pokémon Articuno!
episodes.title: Moving Pictures

episodes.synopsis: Still searching for Articuno, our heroes are found by a trio of keen-nosed, snuffling Swinub, and Team Rocket are keen on sniffing them out for profit!
episodes.title: Spring Fever

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes have finally found Articuno, but they've led Team Rocket right to the Legendary Pokémon as well!
episodes.title: Freeze Frame

episodes.synopsis: Ash and the gang are rescued by a courier service of Arcanine and Growlithe, and in turn must rescue them and their cargo of Fire Stones from the burning ambition of Team Rocket!
episodes.title: The Stolen Stones!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes find themselves in a village that adores Dunsparce and try to help one unlucky Trainer find one of his own!
episodes.title: The Dunsparce Deception

episodes.synopsis: The race is on to find Team Rocket's Wobbuffet when it runs off with the key to an indestructible cage...a cage that holds Ash's Pikachu!
episodes.title: The Wayward Wobbuffet

episodes.synopsis: When Brock falls ill, it's up to Ash and Misty to keep the group well and fed. But their inexperience, and the meddling of Team Rocket, makes their new jobs not-so-simple!
episodes.title: Sick Daze

episodes.synopsis: Ash finds out about a local Pokémon Sumo competition and decides he wants to enter. He has just the Pokémon for the job: the mighty Snorlax!
episodes.title: Ring Masters

episodes.synopsis: A supposed Pokémon translator helps an exhausted Pikachu out on the road, but our heroes soon discover he is wanted by the police for fraud. Whose story do they believe?
episodes.title: The Poké Spokesman

episodes.synopsis: Hearing of ancient relics that allow the wearer to control any Pokémon, Jessie, James, and Meowth are preparing to crash an excavation to dig up the treasure of a lifetime!
episodes.title: Control Freak!

episodes.synopsis: An aging artist and his Smeargle assistants get in some hot water when they attempt to turn a town into their next great masterpiece!
episodes.title: The Art of Pokémon

episodes.synopsis: Brock finally meets his match when another Trainer develops a mad crush on him...but with the tables turned, he's not entirely sure how to behave around her!
episodes.title: The Heartbreak of Brock

episodes.synopsis: After becoming accidentally locked inside an electrical generator, Ash and Chikorita will have to avoid the aggressive security Pokémon and Team Rocket to make it out safely!
episodes.title: Current Events

episodes.synopsis: Bayleef is still getting used to its newly evolved form, and when Ash becomes impatient, it gets upset and runs away. Can our hero find his friend again and make amends?
episodes.title: Turning Over a New Bayleef

episodes.synopsis: A young Natu fortune-teller learning his craft is lacking confidence in front of an audience. Can Ash help encourage the young artist's talent?
episodes.title: Doin' What Comes Natu-rally

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes take part in a high-speed race in a hot air balloon, but the stakes are raised when Team Rocket enters as well, causing chaos in the clouds!
episodes.title: The Big Balloon Blow-Up

episodes.synopsis: When a hooded man leaves a Smoochum with our heroes, it unravels a tale that will take them all the way to the bright lights of the silver screen!
episodes.title: The Screen Actor's Guilt

episodes.synopsis: Ash and his friends are approached by a civil engineer with a problem: she has a team of Ground-type Pokémon working to build a tunnel, but they're terrified of the water that keeps leaking in! Can our heroes help?
episodes.title: Right On, Rhydon!

episodes.synopsis: Aboard a luxury blimp, Team Rocket are trying to pinch a few valuables from wealthy travelers-but some courageous Kecleon are on hand to get the better of them!
episodes.title: The Kecleon Caper

episodes.synopsis: Misty finally meets one of her idols, a Nurse Joy who specializes in Water types! But the reality doesn't live up to the dream when Nurse Joy reveals that she doesn't share Misty's love for aquatic Pokémon after all...
episodes.title: The Joy of Water Pokémon

episodes.synopsis: Ash and his friends have one last obstacle before Olivine City: a scorching desert! And when Cyndaquil goes missing, they have more than the heat to deal with!
episodes.title: Got Miltank?

episodes.synopsis: Ash's next Gym battle is under way, but it's soon called off by Jasmine, the real Olivine Gym Leader, who claims that Ash has been battling an impostor! Will Ash now get the challenge he's been searching for?
episodes.title: Fight for the Light!

episodes.synopsis: After receiving the medicine in Cianwood City, our heroes soon discover the Gym Leader training hard with his Machoke. It's only a matter of time before Ash decides to go toe to toe with Chuck's Fighting-type Pokémon!
episodes.title: Machoke, Machoke Man!

episodes.synopsis: In a scuffle with Team Rocket, Ash and friends are thrown from the ship bearing them to the Whirl Islands! Can they escape the powerful whirlpools that threaten to drag them down?
episodes.title: Around the Whirlpool

episodes.synopsis: The Pidgey on a protected island don't have to worry about being attacked, so most have lost interest in flying. But one of them still dreams of soaring beyond the stars! Can Ash and friends help?
episodes.title: Fly Me to the Moon

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes pass a small mountain village just in time for the annual Chinchou migration. The village always sends Trainers to protect the Chinchou on their journey-but will they be enough to stop Team Rocket?
episodes.title: Takin' It on the Chinchou

episodes.synopsis: When a family's home is threatened by the Corsola who live nearby, it's Ash and friends to the rescue...and maybe Misty can finally catch that Corsola she's been after!
episodes.title: A Corsola Caper!

episodes.synopsis: After our heroes miss a ferry, they meet a diver who offers to take them to the next island...but they're soon distracted by tales of treasure aboard a sunken ship!
episodes.title: Mantine Overboard!

episodes.synopsis: When they're not competing in the Whirl Cup, Ash and Misty try to help a young Trainer whose Octillery has been rejected by its Remoraid friends after evolving.
episodes.title: Octillery the Outcast

episodes.synopsis: After winning their preliminary rounds, Ash and Misty face formidable opponents in the Whirl Cup. Meanwhile, the Team Rocket trio have their eyes on stealing the tournament's prize!
episodes.title: Dueling Heroes

episodes.synopsis: It's the second round of the Whirl Cup, and Ash and Misty have been paired up against each other! Who will come out on top? And will Team Rocket's plan to distract the police be successful?
episodes.title: The Perfect Match!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes are asked to help protect a village from marauders who threaten to make off with the Diglett who live there-and thanks to a delicious dinner, Team Rocket offers to help, too!
episodes.title: Plant It Now... Diglett Later

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes meet a jewelry maker who tells them the legend of the fourth Whirl Island...and who soon finds himself embroiled in a Team Rocket plot!
episodes.title: Hi Ho Silver... Away!

episodes.synopsis: While two sets of Team Rocket villains set out to capture the Legendary Pokémon Lugia, Ash runs into his old friend Richie and his partner, a Pikachu named Sparky!
episodes.title: The Mystery Is History

episodes.synopsis: The little Lugia named Silver has fallen into the hands of Butch and Cassidy of Team Rocket, and with Richie's help, Ash must win the adult Lugia's trust before it gets caught in the same trap!
episodes.title: A Parent Trapped!

episodes.synopsis: While trying to rescue the two Lugia from Team Rocket, Ash and friends have been taken prisoner! Now, they must figure out a way to escape...and to free the captured Pokémon as well!
episodes.title: A Promise Is a Promise

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends are on a plane back to Olivine City when they get caught in a terrible storm that also sweeps up Team Rocket's balloon! They'll have to work together to land safely...but can they manage it?
episodes.title: Throwing in the Noctowl

episodes.synopsis: After several interruptions, including yet another Team Rocket scheme, Ash's battle against Jasmine at the Olivine Gym is finally getting under way!
episodes.title: Nerves of Steelix!

episodes.synopsis: When the Pokémon at Professor Oak's lab in Kanto have a hard time getting along, the professor asks Ash to send his Bulbasaur to the lab so it can help keep the peace.
episodes.title: Bulbasaur... the Ambassador!

episodes.synopsis: In Ecruteak City, our heroes meet up with their friend Sakura and her newly evolved Espeon. Sakura and her sisters are preparing for a dance competition, but Team Rocket is lurking in the wings, hoping to steal their Pokémon...
episodes.title: Espeon, Not Included

episodes.synopsis: When our heroes investigate a sudden pealing of bells, they discover that the Crystal Bells, which are said to ring only when the Legendary Pokémon Ho-Oh returns, are missing! The researcher Eusine seems to know something...
episodes.title: For Ho-Oh the Bells Toll!

episodes.synopsis: When Ash runs into his old rival Gary preparing to enter his Arcanine in a race, he decides to compete as well! But first, he'll have to chase Team Rocket away from the Pokémon Day Care.
episodes.title: Extreme Pokémon!

episodes.synopsis: When the Pokémon Egg given to Ash goes missing, our heroes call on the help of a hapless Officer Jenny. It isn't long before they realize that if they want the Egg back, they'll have to find it themselves!
episodes.title: An EGG-sighting Adventure!

episodes.synopsis: The moment has finally come: a Phanpy has hatched from Ash's Pokémon Egg! The little Pokémon is full of energy and soon charging off...with our heroes and Team Rocket in tow!
episodes.title: Hatching a Plan

episodes.synopsis: Jessie, James, and Meowth take time to lick their wounds and dream of stealing Pikachu for the glory of Team Rocket. After a chance meeting with a Team Rocket scout, it seems these dreams are blasting off before their eyes!
episodes.title: Dues and Don'ts

episodes.synopsis: When thick fog interrupts our heroes' journey, a girl and her Ninetales invite them to rest at a nearby mansion...where Brock and their host fall into a romance that could turn out to be ghostly!
episodes.title: Just Waiting On a Friend

episodes.synopsis: Near Mt. Mortar, our heroes run into a Trainer who is trying to curb a Tyrogue's wild ways. But when Team Rocket gets involved, will they be able to save the troublesome Tyrogue from the villains' clutches?
episodes.title: A Tyrogue Full of Trouble

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes meet a young girl watching over a group of Xatu, whose psychic powers let them predict the future of a local village. When the villagers begin doubting their warnings, can the Xatu prove the truth of their visions?
episodes.title: Xatu the Future

episodes.synopsis: Reaching the Lake of Rage, Pikachu and Togepi begin to feel sick, and our heroes are attacked by an enraged red Gyarados. When Team Rocket appears on the scene, things look a lot more dangerous for Ash and friends...
episodes.title: Talkin' 'Bout an Evolution (1)

episodes.synopsis: Things look bad for our heroes, who have been captured by Team Rocket at the Lake of Rage. With the fate of the world's Pokémon at stake, can Ash rise to the occasion and save the day?
episodes.title: Rage of Innocence (2)

episodes.synopsis: Finally reaching Mahogany Town, Ash is warming up for his next Gym battle. But after getting the cold shoulder from Gym Leader Pryce, can our hero convince his frosty opponent to give him a chance?
episodes.title: As Cold as Pryce

episodes.synopsis: Pryce and Ash are about to clash in a cold contest in the Mahogany Town Gym. Will Ash be able to show what he and his Pokémon are made of and earn his seventh Johto region Gym badge?
episodes.title: Nice Pryce, Baby!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes encounter battling groups of Bellossom and Vileplume, who have only recently evolved. As each group fights with increasing number and intensity, can our heroes put an end to the quarrelling?
episodes.title: Whichever Way the Wind Blows

episodes.synopsis: The heat is rising in our heroes' journey when Misty and her Water-type Pokémon go head to head with a willful Fire-type Trainer!
episodes.title: Some Like It Hot

episodes.synopsis: Ash and the gang bump into a Pokémon magician, and soon they're on the hunt to find components for her greatest spell yet!
episodes.title: Hocus Pokémon

episodes.synopsis: After yet another close encounter with Team Rocket, Pikachu is left exhausted and weak. Thankfully, a passerby takes our heroes to a nearby lake that helps recharge Electric types...but also hides a great secret!
episodes.title: As Clear as Crystal

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes take time out to enjoy the entertainment of a young Trainer and her Igglybuff variety act. But it's not long before Team Rocket arrives and tries to steal the show!
episodes.title: Same Old Song and Dance

episodes.synopsis: A chance trip to a Slowpoke temple gives our heroes an opportunity to seek enlightenment...and gives Team Rocket the chance to lighten some pockets!
episodes.title: Enlighten Up!

episodes.synopsis: A lavish celebrity event inspires Jessie and James to pretend to be the VIPs and fill their rumbling tummies. But it's not long before their disguises are put to the test by the real guest of honor: Professor Oak!
episodes.title: Will the Real Oak Please Stand Up?

episodes.synopsis: When our heroes spot an object falling from the night sky, they rush to investigate. Soon, they find themselves joining forces with a Pokémon mystery club to uncover the secrets shared by the fallen Cleffa and the stars above!
episodes.title: Wish Upon a Star Shape

episodes.synopsis: Ash and Misty get into an argument over who can take on a powerful Trainer and his Poliwrath. When he accepts both challenges, the tough battles that follow give Misty some ideas for her own Poliwhirl!
episodes.title: Outrageous Fortunes

episodes.synopsis: Hearing of a nearby amusement park for battling, Ash is eager to test his skills. But the Team Rocket trio have recently joined the park, and they have a few ideas in store to test this Trainer's mettle!
episodes.title: One Trick Phony!

episodes.synopsis: It's a case of mistaken identity for Misty's Politoed when it gets roped into replacing the leader of a Pokémon Cheer team...but where has the other Politoed gone?
episodes.title: I Politoed Ya So!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends enter an ice cave as it's a shortcut to Blackthorn City. After a watery run-in with Team Rocket, Brock catches a cold and the gang finds a Pokémon Center in the cave. While a Jynx working there is taking care of Brock, Nurse Joy tells Ash and Misty that the cave is cold because of a big building working there as a refrigerator. Team Rocket finds the building and they cause trouble by reversing the structure, heating the cave and cooling the jungle outside, and make their attempt to steal the Ice-type Pokémon as well.
episodes.title: The Ice Cave!

episodes.synopsis: On the outskirts of Blackthorn City, Ash meets Gym Leader Clair, who is busy training her Dratini for a ceremony. But Team Rocket has other plans for the Dragon-type Pokémon, and Ash and Clair must work together to stop them!
episodes.title: Beauty Is Skin Deep

episodes.synopsis: Facing off against Blackthorn Gym Leader Clair, Ash is finding it difficult to overcome the power of her Dragon-type Pokémon. Things are harder still when Team Rocket shows up to steal Blackthorn City's prized Dragon Fang relic!
episodes.title: Fangs for Nothin'

episodes.synopsis: Team Rocket has taken the Blackthorn City Dragon Fang and holed up deep within the Dragon's Den. Things look bad for the ancient relic, but help comes in the form of an old friend!
episodes.title: Great Bowls of Fire!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and Clair finally face off in a Gym battle that will push Ash's skills as a Trainer to the limit! Can he win his final Johto Gym badge?
episodes.title: Better Eight Than Never

episodes.synopsis: A Team Rocket trick takes all of Ash's hard-earned Johto Gym badges from him, but it's not long before the troublesome trio get a taste of their own medicine. What tricksy Pokémon could have beaten them at their own game?
episodes.title: Why? Wynaut!

episodes.synopsis: Discovering a nearby Pokémon synchronized swim team, Misty goes to check it out, and soon finds herself heading below the surface to take on the team's Trainer in an exciting underwater battle!
episodes.title: Just Add Water

episodes.synopsis: Ash barely makes it back to New Bark Town before he is off again, retrieving a Pokémon Egg for Professor Elm. However, things get interesting when he meets an old friend and Team Rocket shows up with more mischief!
episodes.title: Lapras of Luxury

episodes.synopsis: Professor Elm's Pokémon Egg hatches into a Larvitar! The Pokémon is unresponsive even after being checked over at the Pokémon Center, and Ash tries to cheer it up, but soon Team Rocket arrives to ruin all his hard work.
episodes.title: Hatch Me If You Can

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Mt. Silver, our heroes relax at a hot spring and meet a young Trainer who's tracking the Legendary Pokémon Entei. Trouble arises when Team Rocket follows them with a plan to steal Pikachu and Larvitar!
episodes.title: Entei at Your Own Risk

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes find a group of Slowpoke guarding a dried-up stream and hear the tale of a similar drought long ago, when one Slowpoke took the initiative to evolve into Slowking and save everyone. Can the same thing happen here?
episodes.title: A Crowning Achievement

episodes.synopsis: A cheeky Elekid starts to bother Larvitar, but soon both Pokémon are in the clutches of Team Rocket. Ash's rival Casey wants to catch Elekid for herself, but can they mount a rescue before the villains get away?
episodes.title: Here's Lookin' at You, Elekid

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes have reached Mt. Silver, and Ash wastes no time starting his training for the Johto League Silver Conference. But all the Trainers around provide the perfect prey for Team Rocket, who arrive to swipe all the rare Pokémon!
episodes.title: You're a Star, Larvitar!

episodes.synopsis: With Mt. Silver a few yards away, Ash and co. soon spot an Unown, which quickly becomes friends with Larvitar. After which, it was attacked by Team Rocket and soon Ash and friends are swept into another dimension. Where are they now and where is Larvitar? And how did Pikachu and Togepi become giants?
episodes.title: Address Unown!

episodes.synopsis: After finally arriving at Mt. Silver, Ash and co. find the Preserve where Larvitar was born. There they encounter Larvitar's mother, the same Tyranitar that was in Larvitar's visions. The reunion is not a happy one however, even after they get reunited. The three men from Larvitar's visions were also the ones responsible for stealing its Egg and they managed to capture the Tyranitar. Can they get mother and child reunited with the help of Ranger Mason?
episodes.title: Mother of All Battles

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes are called into action to save the Johto League Silver Conference's opening ceremony from being stopped by a territorial Sneasel!
episodes.title: Pop Goes the Sneasel

episodes.synopsis: The Johto League Silver Conference has begun, and Ash and his rivals are getting serious about what the future has in store!
episodes.title: A Claim to Flame!

episodes.synopsis: As the Johto League Silver Conference heats up, Ash will have to rely on some old friends to fight off the affections of his next opponent!
episodes.title: Love, Pokémon Style

episodes.synopsis: The battle between Ash and Macy is over and Ash wins, but the next battle will determine if he will or will not go to the victory tournament. He faces off against Jackson, a trainer from Twinleaf Town who has a Meganium like Casey. Will Ash be able to win this final battle of the elimination block?
episodes.title: Tie One On!

episodes.synopsis: It's Ash versus his oldest rival, Gary, in the Johto League Silver Conference, and both Trainers are ready to give it all they've got. But who will come out on top?
episodes.title: The Ties That Bind

episodes.synopsis: The ultimate battle continues as Ash and Gary face off. Ash will have to come up with a new plan to beat Gary's Blastoise. Can he do it with the Pokémon he's got, and if Ash beats Gary, who will be his next opponent?
episodes.title: Can't Beat the Heat!

episodes.synopsis: After defeating Gary in the last round, Ash has to take on his new friend Harrison in the Johto League Silver Conference. Will our hero be able to stop the challenger from the Hoenn region?
episodes.title: Playing with Fire!

episodes.synopsis: The scorching battle between Ash and Harrison rages on, with Charizard taking on Blaziken, a Pokémon from the Hoenn region!
episodes.title: Johto Photo Finish

episodes.synopsis: With his Johto League adventure behind him, Ash has decided to head back to Pallet Town. But it's all too soon before he has to say goodbye to Brock and Misty, and head out alone for a new adventure!
episodes.title: Gotta Catch Ya Later!

episodes.synopsis: The Hoenn region is on Ash's mind, and he's preparing to board a ship bound there when Team Rocket strikes! With Pikachu missing and time running out before the boat leaves, can Ash get his adventure back on track?
episodes.title: Hoenn Alone!
